content:
liam: Hey @people-ops — quick heads up, I've been having intermittent vertigo and balance episodes at the office this month. Yesterday I had to step out from my desk. I'm requesting a temporary hybrid schedule (3 remote / 2 onsite) and to be moved to a ground-floor desk near the exit for now. I've attached a short note from my clinician. Appreciate guidance on next steps.

devon: Thanks for flagging, Liam. Support this. Can confirm we can swap desk assignments this week. Re: schedule, happy to cover flexibility.

jordan (People Ops): Thanks @liam and @devon. Can you drop the clinician note here or email it to people-ops@redwood.com? We'll start the interactive process. Need expected duration, and whether you need any on-site accommodations (ergonomic chair, step stool, non-slip mat).

liam: Uploaded to the case: [redacted_clinician_note.pdf] — says 'intermittent vestibular episodes, recommend reduced stairs and flexible schedule for 8 weeks'.

people-ops-bot: Case #PO-2026-487 created. Assigned to jordan. Please allow 48 hours for review.

jordan (People Ops): Got it. We'll propose: (1) temporary hybrid schedule 3/2, (2) ground-floor desk swap effective Mon 03/30, (3) ergonomic stool and non-slip mat. Devon — can team coordinate desk swap and keycard access?

devon: On it. I'll ping facilities to reserve ground-floor desk and handle desk swap logistics.

liam: Thanks, appreciate it. Will this affect my performance review or oncall rotation?

jordan (People Ops): This is an accommodation request; it shouldn't negatively impact your review. If oncall duties require onsite presence, we can reassign or adjust shifts during the accommodation. We'll document changes in PO case.

liam: OK. One more thing — I sometimes get nauseous in busy open-floor areas. Can we request a quieter corner on the ground floor?

jordan (People Ops): Noted. We'll request a quieter corner and prioritize low-traffic seating. Adding action items: facilities desk swap, ergonomic kit order, update keycard access, adjust oncall if needed. Expect confirmation by 03/28.

devon: :thumbsup:

liam: Thank you everyone.
